test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which state is the Hogenakkal Falls located ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Hogennekkal falls is located in Dharmapuri district of the state of Tamilnadu.
 
• It is formed on the Kaveri River.
 
• Kaveri River flows through the states of Karnataka and Tamilnadu and empties in the Bay of Bengal.
